description: Non-aggregate scalar subquery over a NOT NULL column is nullable, because zero matching rows makes the subquery evaluate to SQL NULL regardless of the projected column's own nullability

columns.name: first_order_total
columns.note: orders.total is NOT NULL, but the scalar subquery returns SQL NULL when no order matches, so the result is nullable even with LIMIT 1

name: scalar_subquery_non_aggregate_nullable
query_sql:
-- @name GetFirstOrderTotal
-- @returns :many
SELECT id, (SELECT total FROM orders WHERE orders.user_id = users.id LIMIT 1) AS first_order_total FROM users
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE users (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', bio TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now())
CREATE TABLE orders (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), total INTEGER NOT NULL, notes TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now())
